age_at_visit.name: Age at Visit
age_at_visit.description: Calculates the subject's age at the time of the baseline visit. This is a prerequisite for many clinical scores.
age_at_visit.expression: Age in years = (B0 VISIT DATE - birthdate) / 365.25

body_mass_index.name: Body Mass Index (BMI)
body_mass_index.description: A measure of body fat based on height and weight. Assumes height is in meters and weight is in kilograms.

body_surface_area_dubois.name: Body Surface Area (Du Bois)
body_surface_area_dubois.description: Calculates the total surface area of the human body. Commonly used for indexing cardiac parameters and for chemotherapy dosing. Assumes height in cm and weight in kg.

egfr_ckd_epi_2021.name: eGFR (CKD-EPI 2021 Race-Free)
egfr_ckd_epi_2021.description: Estimates Glomerular Filtration Rate from serum creatinine, age, and sex using the 2021 CKD-EPI race-free equation.
egfr_ckd_epi_2021.expression: 142 * (min(Creatinine / κ, 1))^α * (max(Creatinine / κ, 1))^(-1.200) * 0.9938^Age * (1.012 if Female). Where κ is 0.7 for females and 0.9 for males, α is -0.241 for females and -0.302 for males.

homa_ir.name: HOMA-IR (Insulin Resistance)
homa_ir.description: The Homeostatic Model Assessment for Insulin Resistance (HOMA-IR) is a method used to quantify insulin resistance and beta-cell function. Assumes standard units (μU/mL for insulin, mmol/L for glucose).

fib_4_index.name: FIB-4 Index for Liver Fibrosis
fib_4_index.description: A non-invasive score to estimate liver fibrosis based on standard laboratory tests.

apri_score.name: APRI (AST to Platelet Ratio Index)
apri_score.description: A non-invasive method to assess liver fibrosis, calculated from AST and platelet count. The formula requires the upper limit of normal (ULN) for AST, which is not provided and must be assumed (e.g., 40 U/L).

de_ritis_ratio.name: De Ritis Ratio (AST/ALT)
de_ritis_ratio.description: The ratio of Aspartate Aminotransferase (AST) to Alanine Aminotransferase (ALT). A ratio > 2 may suggest alcoholic liver disease, while a ratio < 1 is common in non-alcoholic fatty liver disease.

non_hdl_cholesterol.name: Non-HDL Cholesterol
non_hdl_cholesterol.description: Calculates the total cholesterol minus the high-density lipoprotein (HDL) cholesterol, representing all atherogenic lipoprotein particles.

ejection_fraction_from_volumes.name: Ejection Fraction (from Volumes)
ejection_fraction_from_volumes.description: The fraction of blood pumped out of the left ventricle with each contraction, calculated from end-diastolic and end-systolic volumes.

stroke_volume_from_volumes.name: Stroke Volume (from LVEDV/LVESV)
stroke_volume_from_volumes.description: The volume of blood pumped from the left ventricle per beat, calculated as the difference between end-diastolic volume and end-systolic volume.

stroke_volume_from_lvot.name: Stroke Volume (from LVOT)
stroke_volume_from_lvot.description: The volume of blood pumped from the left ventricle per beat, calculated using the LVOT diameter and Velocity Time Integral (VTI).

cardiac_output_sv_hr.name: Cardiac Output (from Stroke Volume & Heart Rate)
cardiac_output_sv_hr.description: The volume of blood pumped by the heart per minute. This formula calculates it from derived stroke volume and heart rate.
cardiac_output_sv_hr.expression: Stroke_Volume * Heart rate = (LVEDV - LVESV) * Heart rate

e_a_ratio.name: E/A Ratio (Mitral Inflow)
e_a_ratio.description: Ratio of early (E) to late/atrial (A) diastolic mitral inflow velocity. A key parameter in assessing diastolic function.

e_e_prime_ratio.name: E/e' Ratio (Diastolic Function)
e_e_prime_ratio.description: Ratio of early mitral inflow velocity (E) to mitral annular early diastolic velocity (e'). An estimate of LV filling pressure. An average of septal and lateral e' is typically used.

relative_wall_thickness.name: Relative Wall Thickness (RWT)
relative_wall_thickness.description: An index of left ventricular geometry used to classify patterns of LV hypertrophy (concentric vs. eccentric).

lv_mass_devereux.name: Left Ventricular Mass (Devereux)
lv_mass_devereux.description: Estimation of left ventricular mass using the anatomically validated Devereux formula.

mean_arterial_pressure.name: Mean Arterial Pressure (MAP)
mean_arterial_pressure.description: The average arterial pressure during a single cardiac cycle, considered a better indicator of tissue perfusion than systolic blood pressure alone.
mean_arterial_pressure.expression: Diastolic blood pressure + (1/3 * (Systolic blood pressure - Diastolic blood pressure))

pulse_pressure.name: Pulse Pressure (PP)
pulse_pressure.description: The difference between systolic and diastolic blood pressure, representing the force the heart generates each time it contracts.
pulse_pressure.expression: Systolic blood pressure - Diastolic blood pressure

cha2ds2_vasc_score.name: CHA₂DS₂-VASc Score (Conceptual)
cha2ds2_vasc_score.description: Estimates stroke risk in atrial fibrillation. Full calculation is not possible due to missing history of Stroke/TIA and Vascular Disease. This entry outlines the available components.
cha2ds2_vasc_score.expression: C(CHF):1pt; H(HTN):1pt; A₂(Age≥75):2pts; D(Diabetes):1pt; S₂(Stroke):2pts[NA]; V(Vasc Dis):1pt[NA]; A(Age 65-74):1pt; Sc(Sex female):1pt.

cholesterol_mmol_to_mgdl.name: Cholesterol Unit Conversion (mmol/L to mg/dL)
cholesterol_mmol_to_mgdl.description: Converts cholesterol values from mmol/L to mg/dL.

triglycerides_mmol_to_mgdl.name: Triglycerides Unit Conversion (mmol/L to mg/dL)
triglycerides_mmol_to_mgdl.description: Converts triglyceride values from mmol/L to mg/dL.
